accuracy_notes: Photo-informed original artwork: Leptobarbus cf. hoevenii, Sultan fish visual study. Animated tail and fins; not a scanned specimen or taxonomic identification model. The supplied Sultan fish / Ikan jelawat is interpreted as Leptobarbus cf. hoevenii. The inspected 2009 aquarium photograph uses the older broad name; L. rubripinna is now separately valid in the CAS catalog. The artwork is not a certified identification of that photograph or an exact stock.
